recentItems.title: “Your Idol” Official Choreography | KPop Demon Hunters | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Official choreography for “Your Idol” from the hit Netflix film, KPop Demon Hunters.
Watch KPop Demon Hunters, only on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/81498621

Choreography by K-Tigers
Dancers: Ha Seong Jin, Lee Ok Hyun, Kim Tae Sung, Roh Jun Seo, Kim Seong Hyun

“Your Idol”
Written by EJAE, Mark Sonnenblick, Vince, KUSH, 24 and IDO
Produced by 24, IDO and Ian Eisendrath
Performed by Andrew Choi, Neckwav, Danny Chung, Kevin Woo and samUIL Lee

KPop Demon Hunters, directed by Maggie Kang and Chris Appelhans, became a global phenomenon shortly following its release in 2025. The film is Netflix’s most popular film of all time, surpassing over 670 million views with 63 consecutive weeks on Netflix’s Global Top 10.

It swept every award category: winning Best Animated Feature at the Academy Awards, Critics’ Choice Awards, Golden Globes, as well as ten Annie Awards. Its breakout song “Golden” became the first K-pop track to win both an Oscar and a Grammy. The soundtrack continues to make history as the first to place four songs simultaneously in the Billboard Hot 100 top ten, accumulating over 15 billion global streams. “Golden” held No. 1 on the Hot 100 for eight weeks — the longest such run by a female group this century — and was certified 5x Platinum.

recentItems.title: Primetime Preacher$ | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
In the 1980s, three of the most powerful televangelists in America - Jim Bakker, Jerry Falwell, and Jimmy Swaggart - harnessed the power of television to build vast media ministries, reaching millions of viewers during coveted primetime hours and turning everyday preachers into household names. As these religious programs grew into international broadcasting empires built in God's name, these men transformed evangelical Christianity from a largely nonpartisan movement into a powerful force in American politics whose influence still reverberates today. When a shocking and very public sex scandal erupted, it ignited an all-out holy war among the three men — one that captivated the nation and exposed what lay beneath the empires they’d built. This documentary from Academy Award nominee Joe Berlinger (Paradise Lost; Metallica: Some Kind of Monster) investigates the greed, ego, and rivalry that was building behind the pulpit during the golden age of televangelism.
